Dolly Parton’s legacy reaches far beyond music. She believed in giving children the opportunity to dream, learn, and succeed.

Her commitment to education and generosity were evident from her Imagination Library, which helped place books in the hands of more kids, to her assistance with Union Medical Center’s renovation in the Upstate, an area her mother once called home.

Her lasting contributions will continue to inspire the next generation to dream big.
